independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier, session 4c79dba1-b7f7-4e94-9c7c-823c8271051c, task T-DG7-REV-QA-R3. I checked the assignment's sha256 (9a42fd0c8401f4414e30d2f27f78cf15c4b4cc156412c0438c414ff5d1db705e) at the start. In this run I wrote no product implementation, no test in the candidate, no register row, ADR, handover text, repair or delivery decision, and I changed no candidate file. My probes (an order sequencer config, revert-to-fail edits, a fake rm on PATH, the A18 driver) ran in disposable clones under $TMPDIR, which I removed at the end. Their scripts are kept as evidence outside the candidate. The implementer roles listed wrote the product, tools, guides, register and repairs (BE-R7, DO-D8, DO-D8B, AN-P7F); the orchestrator froze the candidate and regenerated the handover texts. I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-3 record, and I have not read them. Their run commits (30c29f6c0, 93679b227) appeared during my run. I did not open them, and they change no file outside docs/delivery. My protocol-audit run scanned the live repository, which may have included those run directories. I used only the audit's counts and the hits I cite, which concern implementation handbacks, not their conclusions.
